About our workwear

Workwear your team will actually wear.

We stock trusted blanks — Gildan, Bella+Canvas, Champion and Carhartt — and decorate them in-house.

Guidelines & file prep

Artwork that prints clean on fabric.

Which method suits your artwork, and what file to send for it.

SérigraphieVector artwork, 1–4 spot colours · best value at 24+ pieces
Transfert DTFAny artwork, full colour · PNG with transparent background, 300 DPI at print size
BroderieVector logo; we digitize it (one-time $45 fee) · keep text above 0.25 in tall
Vinyle thermocollantVector; solid colours only · ideal for names and numbers
Print sizesLeft chest 3.5–4 in · full front up to 12 × 14 in · full back up to 13 × 16 in · sleeve 3 in
SizingMixed sizes welcome on one order; size chart on request
  1. Send your logoVector (AI, EPS, SVG, PDF) if you have it; a high-res PNG works for DTF.
  2. Pick garment, colour and placementUse the customizer, or tell us and we’ll set it up.
  3. Approve the mockupWe send a proof with the print sized in inches on the garment colour you chose.
  4. Production5–7 business days for most orders; rush on request.
Screen print and embroidery colours are matched to Pantone; DTF is full-colour CMYK.

Questions fréquentes

Questions we get asked most.

Still unsure? Send us a note and we’ll answer within one business day.

All FAQsContactez-nous
Is there a minimum order?
Screen printing starts at 12 pieces because of screen setup. DTF and embroidery have no minimum — one hoodie is fine, it just costs a little more per piece.
Which method should I choose?
Screen print for simple logos in volume; DTF for full-colour or photographic art in any quantity; embroidery for a premium, long-lasting finish on polos, caps and workwear; vinyl for names and numbers.
Can I mix sizes and colours?
Yes. One order can have any mix of sizes; garment colours can be mixed as long as the print colours stay the same.
Will the print crack or fade?
Screen prints and embroidery outlast the garment when washed inside-out in cold water. DTF is rated for 50+ washes. We include care instructions with every order.
Can I supply my own garments?
Sometimes — ask first. We can’t guarantee results on fabrics we haven’t tested, and we don’t replace customer-supplied garments if a print fails.

Need a team outfitted?

Send your logo and a rough size breakdown; we’ll return a mockup and a per-piece price within one business day.
